agent_claimed: Assess payment link feasibility by attempting to create a Stripe payment link
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for tool call 2 was to assess payment link feasibility by attempting to create a Stripe payment link.

agent_claimed: Retrieve workflows to verify asset status and inertness
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for tool call 5 was to retrieve workflows to verify asset status and inertness.
judge_said: None of the returned tools provide the capability to verify that HubSpot assets remain inert.

capability: Fetch and read email messages and threads
agent_claimed: Fetch Gmail profile to check account availability and productivity signals
match_reason: The agent used GMAIL_GET_PROFILE with the purpose of checking account availability and productivity signals, which served as its attempt to interact with email services.
judge_said: None of the returned Gmail tools provide the capability to fetch and read email messages and threads.

capability: Mark incomplete archive documents when transcript retrieval fails
agent_claimed: Attempt to retrieve video transcript for knowledge base update
match_reason: Tool call 3 was used to attempt transcript retrieval, which directly aligns with the condition for marking incomplete archive documents when that retrieval fails.
judge_said: None of the returned tools provide the capability to mark or update incomplete archive documents when transcript retrieval fails.

capability: Audit website search performance and indexing
agent_claimed: Attempt to check GA4 metadata or run report to audit website traffic and search performance
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for the first call was to audit website traffic and search performance.
judge_said: The returned tools only provide Google Analytics (GA4) and Gmail functionalities, but none of them support auditing website search performance and indexing like Google Search Console.

capability: Prepare and manage email marketing or contact lists
agent_claimed: Retrieve Gmail contacts to prepare email marketing and outreach lists
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for tool call 3 was to retrieve Gmail contacts in order to prepare email marketing and outreach lists.
judge_said: None of the returned tools provide the capability to create and manage email marketing lists or contact lists.

capability: Investigate hosting and deployment state via DNS/CDN configuration
agent_claimed: List Vercel deployments to check hosting and deployment state
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for running the VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS tool was to check the hosting and deployment state.

capability: Attempt social media publishing on Instagram

capability: Read and update the booking schedule
agent_claimed: Search calendar events to read booking schedule
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated the purpose of tool call 6 was to search calendar events to read the booking schedule.

capability: Search and extract recent job listings from web sources or job boards
agent_claimed: Search job boards or listings for remote or hybrid contract data-engineering-related jobs in a target region
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose was to search job boards or listings for remote or hybrid contract data-engineering-related jobs in a target region.

capability: Manage and reconcile files in Google Drive

match_reason: Tool call 2 explicitly searched Google Drive to find and reconcile portal, billing, or project documentation files.

capability: Gather web analytics and traffic performance data
agent_claimed: List accessible Meta ad accounts to gather marketing performance data
match_reason: The agent explicitly stated its purpose for the first tool call was to gather marketing performance data.
